corpusValidation.method: integer income ledger: income = startMoney(r) − startMoney(r−1) + moneySpent(r−1); modeled = round reward + loss bonus + plant/defuse + kill rewards (weapon table) + CT team award + TK; residual = income − modeled; diff=0 expected
corpusValidation.run: 2026-08-06, 316 matches / 60325 samples (Cologne 202 + rival + Windows corpus); final: 89-90% diff=0, 100% integer residuals; remaining ±200/±500/±300 = buytime-tail moneySpent blind spot (4/1595), weapon-map edge cases, loss-counter cap boundary

results.killRewards: weapon table (weapons.v2026-08-06.json, GameTracking-CS2 2e606a0b): awp 100, p90 300, cz75a 300, xm1014 600, knife 1500, smg 600; unknown weapons reported, never guessed
results.ctTeamKillReward: confirmed 50×T-eliminated per CT (victim 口径, round-end settlement)
results.time_ran_out: T survivors receive NO loss bonus (261 rounds audited, zero counter-examples); dead T receive the table payout

notes.lossBonusRule: mp_starting_losses=1 → half starts count 1; loss +1 (cap 4); win decrement UNRESOLVED (corpus: payout-tier drop 1 across any win; candidate internal decrement 2 under documented update order; cap decrement runtime-unverified — see docs/experiments/loss-counter-runtime.md)
notes.buytime: mp_buytime 20 counts from freeze end (H2): buys observed at freezeEnd+19.6s; exact close unverified (controlled test pending)
notes.moneySpent: snapshot of native m_iCashSpentThisRound at round_freeze_end; excludes post-freeze buys/refunds; sellback semantics unresolved
notes.pricesSource: weapon prices from generated weapons.v2026-08-06.json (GameTracking-CS2 2e606a0b, incl. bizon 1300 2026 drop); non-weapon prices in this file
